|lore=Falleen gangster and leader. Black Sun agent. Dark Prince of the Black Sun crime syndicate. Fortifies his personal defenses with information gathered by his agents.<ref name="foil-face" />
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When in battle at a site, draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and total ability of 6 or more required for opponent to draw battle destiny here. Immune to attrition &lt; 5 while Vader not here.<ref name="foil-face" />
